race.comment: MAGNARDO (1) had a phenomenal last season, not finishing further back than second in 13 starts - including 10 wins - so there's no reason to think she can't go on with it. Does have a wide draw to overcome but gets in nicely after the claim. Giga Kick's half-brother PANTOJA (5) has been about the mark without winning, the latest offering a sixth over 1000m at this track. Backmarker who gets home hard and will appreciate this class of race. BLONDIE'S TORONADO (2) was allowed to drift back from an outside draw last time but found the line strongly to finish fifth, beaten 3.5 lengths, over 1200m at Ballarat Synthetic. Solid top-three prospects. RACETOTHEBOTTOM (3) finished third last start at the first run back from a spell over 1200m at this track, beaten 5.5 lengths. Yet to miss the frame in two starts over this course and distance.
